status: proposed; not an implemented endpoint contract or formal JSON Schema
purpose: Configure one progressive authoring editor and validate structured drafts.

editor.autoSave: Save drafts with optimistic revision and visible save state; preserve undo/recovery.
editor.typeChange: Preview incompatible fields; preserve original data until explicitly migrated; never silently discard.

referenceRules.contentRef: Use {ref: id}; target must be present or explicitly declared as an external content dependency.
referenceRules.blockRef: Use a stable block ID; validate that its parent record is accessible.
referenceRules.runtimeRef: Resolved in the campaign only; excluded from reusable module definitions.
referenceRules.dependencyRef: References an entry in package.dependencies; resolve version/entitlement on import.
referenceRules.assetRef: References package.assets; never arbitrary local paths or privileged URLs.
referenceRules.mention: Mentions may suggest ABOUT/REFERENCES. Semantic facts, grants and outcomes require explicit review.

richText.text: Author text with optional [[stable-id|display name]] links; no executable HTML.

profiles.label: Adventure / module
profiles.guideProjection: Adventure overview, hooks, readiness, pacing, chapter navigation and endings.
profiles.authoringNotes: A complete module references existing content; it does not duplicate every linked record.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Chapter / act
profiles.guideProjection: Chapter overview, current objectives, branches and location index.
profiles.authoringNotes: Chapter order is presentation order; it must not force a linear play history.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Dungeon level / floor
profiles.guideProjection: Floor map, keyed area index, general features, factions, travel and revisit changes.
profiles.authoringNotes: General features apply to rooms unless a room explicitly overrides them; room secrets never inherit a public audience.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Place / city / site / room
profiles.guideProjection: Places tab, room description, exits, map, occupants, local lore and discoveries.
profiles.authoringNotes: Subtype controls visible fields: cities show districts/services; rooms show area key, exits and map anchor. A session uses a scene linked to this place, not a copied place.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Scene / place in a session
profiles.guideProjection: Session beats, immediate situation, present cast, read-aloud, encounters and next steps.
profiles.authoringNotes: Outcomes are authored possibilities. Playing the scene records an actual event separately.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Story / plot thread
profiles.guideProjection: Story overview, unresolved threads, stakes and consequences.
profiles.authoringNotes: Write flexible pressures and opportunities; never assert future player choices as events.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Story beat
profiles.guideProjection: Preparation checklist and branching story progression.
profiles.authoringNotes: Essential means required for this authored scenario to resolve, not a compulsory player decision.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: World lore / encyclopedia

fields.label: How can this matter at the table?

profiles.guideProjection: Lore tab, location history, linked references and authorized Loom citations.
profiles.authoringNotes: An article can exist without a session or adventure. Link a clue/scene to it to make it actionable. Mentioning an entity creates ABOUT only, never a factual relationship.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Session plan / reusable session template
profiles.guideProjection: Session guide, beats, relevant cast, places, lore and resources.
profiles.authoringNotes: No real player IDs, completion flags or actual XP awards in a reusable session template.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Played session / recap
profiles.guideProjection: Session history and authorized Loom evidence; runtime-only.
profiles.authoringNotes: Draft recaps can be edited. Approved history is corrected through audited revisions; events and awards are not silently rewritten.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Encounter: combat / social / exploration
profiles.guideProjection: Encounter card, launch setup, tactical notes, alternatives, rewards and aftermath.
profiles.authoringNotes: Combat requires combatant templates and positions; social requires agendas and leverage; exploration requires an obstacle and consequences. Live HP/initiative/resources belong to encounter instances.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: NPC
profiles.guideProjection: NPC dossier and scene-specific cast.
profiles.authoringNotes: NPC knowledge does not grant player access. Current position is runtime state.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.label: Faction
profiles.guideProjection: Local factions, motivations, pressures and consequences.
profiles.authoringNotes: Secret faction agendas are separate GM blocks.
profiles.readinessPolicy: Required-at-ready fields apply only to this selected profile; package checks also validate referenced dependencies.

profiles.guideProjection: Quest tracker, leads, prerequisites and rewards.
profiles.authoringNotes: Provide alternative leads for essential deductions; do not silently solve investigations for players.

relationships.meaning: Discusses a subject, no factual assertion
Potential discovery path, not actual grant
Actor connected to a story pressure

requireCustom: Participants have agendas and leverage; include a noncombat resolution.
Define obstacle, progress/resolution rule and failure consequence.

draft: Title and kind; allow incomplete sections; server verifies campaign edit access.
ready: No dangling block or asset refs
approve: Approved revision indexed for authorized Loom retrieval; drafts excluded
package: No account IDs or private play state
play: Never change canon merely by checking a planned beat

conditions.evaluation: Server-side allowlisted interpreter; missing hidden state never leaks through condition results; no JavaScript, SQL or Cypher in content.

guideQuery.expansion: Session plan -> planned scenes -> locations, encounters, cast, authored clues/hazards/rewards -> directly linked lore and sources; bounded traversal.
guideQuery.whyIncluded: Return authorized relationship path and inclusion reason per result.
guideQuery.security: Apply audience and source permissions before counts, traversal explanations, citations, preview or asset delivery.

persistence.write: Authorized SQL transaction writes revisions, links and pending outbox; retryable versioned projector updates graph.
gaps: New profile kinds and data require reviewed enum/typed-table migrations.
Do not persist every detail in metadata_json: normalize references, ownership, grants, conditions used by rules and mutable state.
Package templates must be independent of campaign-specific nodes and runtime identities.
